article.body:
arXiv Publishes Paper on Policy Regret in Model Routing

The arXiv cs.AI repository published the research paper “Policy Regret for Embedding Model Routing: Contextual Bandits with Low-Rank Experts” on 28 September 2026. The publication makes the paper available for review but does not establish an operational model-routing capability, requirement, or restriction for contractors, companies, or government agencies. The record identifies no strategic objective, implementation, contract, or funding commitment attached to the research.
